title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第四章、亲生父亲

    阴云密布，通往南湖亭的大路上，两人两马正在飞跑，他们是包拯和公孙策。
    “什么线索都没有，居然就说以死谢罪，你是不想活了吗！”从开封府出来，公孙策一路都在骂包拯。
    公孙策是开封府的师爷，也就是包拯的助理。他瘦瘦高高，肤色白净，身上透着书生气，因此比起师爷，他更像个书生。他在开封府已经工作好几年了，除了师爷这个身份，他还是包拯最好的朋友。当他从包拯那里听说了血衣案的情况，马上就急了。这个案子和平时的案子不一样，这一次要查的人是王爷、是皇宫，说不定还有更大的人，这太难了，也太危险了。
    “我们现在就是去找线索啊！放心吧，南湖亭一定有线索！”包拯语气轻松，居然还在笑。公孙策更生气了，他踢了一脚马肚子，跑到前面不理包拯了。
    包拯跟上来，收住笑容，真诚地说：“我知道你是担心我，但我相信你和我一样，都没办法对一个关心父亲的儿子说‘不’。不管他是不是皇帝，我都要把八王爷带回来。”
    是的，骂归骂，公孙策和包拯其实是一样的人，他们都没有办法对关心父亲的皇帝说“不”。皇帝赵真不是先皇帝的儿子，而是八王爷的独子，这是全国百姓都知道的事情。赵真从小在王府长大，在他十七岁那年，宫里的太子生病死了。皇帝没有别的儿子，太子是下个皇帝的唯一人选。太子死了，就意味着将来的皇帝死了，国家马上会乱。伤心的皇帝想了很久，他想到了弟弟的儿子。皇帝的弟弟是八王爷，八王爷的儿子就是赵真。皇帝把十七岁的赵真接进了宫里，封他做了新的太子。三年后，皇帝死了，太子赵真就成了皇帝。
    赵真进宫以前，一直和八王爷生活在一起。八王爷也只有赵真这一个儿子，八王爷的妻子在赵真出生后没多久就去世了，之后八王爷没有再结婚，他把所有的爱都给了儿子。现在是谁绑架了八王爷？他可是皇帝的亲生父亲，谁这么大胆？绑架目的又是什么？这些都是包拯要查清楚的问题，也是公孙策担心包拯的原因。
    南湖到了。湖水平静，湖面巨大，一眼望不到边。岸边有个大亭子，这就是南湖亭。天气好的时候，会有一些书生来这里游玩。包拯和公孙策在亭子里仔细看了半天，没有发现线索。
fullText.traditional:
第四章、親生父親

    陰雲密布，通往南湖亭的大路上，兩人兩馬正在飛跑，他們是包拯和公孫策。
    “什麼線索都沒有，居然就說以死謝罪，你是不想活了嗎！”從開封府出來，公孫策一路都在罵包拯。
    公孫策是開封府的師爺，也就是包拯的助理。他瘦瘦高高，膚色白淨，身上透著書生氣，因此比起師爺，他更像個書生。他在開封府已經工作好幾年了，除了師爺這個身份，他還是包拯最好的朋友。當他從包拯那裡聽說了血衣案的情況，馬上就急了。這個案子和平時的案子不一樣，這一次要查的人是王爺、是皇宮，說不定還有更大的人，這太難了，也太危險了。
    “我們現在就是去找線索啊！放心吧，南湖亭一定有線索！”包拯語氣輕鬆，居然還在笑。公孫策更生氣了，他踢了一腳馬肚子，跑到前面不理包拯了。
    包拯跟上來，收住笑容，真誠地說：“我知道你是擔心我，但我相信你和我一樣，都沒辦法對一個關心父親的兒子說‘不’。不管他是不是皇帝，我都要把八王爺帶回來。”
    是的，罵歸罵，公孫策和包拯其實是一樣的人，他們都沒有辦法對關心父親的皇帝說“不”。皇帝趙真不是先皇帝的兒子，而是八王爺的獨子，這是全國百姓都知道的事情。趙真從小在王府長大，在他十七歲那年，宮裡的太子生病死了。皇帝沒有別的兒子，太子是下個皇帝的唯一人選。太子死了，就意味著將來的皇帝死了，國家馬上會亂。傷心的皇帝想了很久，他想到了弟弟的兒子。皇帝的弟弟是八王爺，八王爺的兒子就是趙真。皇帝把十七歲的趙真接進了宮裡，封他做了新的太子。三年後，皇帝死了，太子趙真就成了皇帝。
    趙真進宮以前，一直和八王爺生活在一起。八王爺也只有趙真這一個兒子，八王爺的妻子在趙真出生後沒多久就去世了，之後八王爺沒有再結婚，他把所有的愛都給了兒子。現在是誰綁架了八王爺？他可是皇帝的親生父親，誰這麼大膽？綁架目的又是什麼？這些都是包拯要查清楚的問題，也是公孫策擔心包拯的原因。
    南湖到了。湖水平靜，湖面巨大，一眼望不到邊。岸邊有個大亭子，這就是南湖亭。天氣好的時候，會有一些書生來這裡遊玩。包拯和公孫策在亭子裡仔細看了半天，沒有發現線索。

sentences.english: .. and also the reasons why Gongsun Ce was worried about Bao Zheng.

sentences.simplified: 南湖到了。湖水平静，湖面巨大，一眼望不到边。
sentences.traditional: 南湖到了。湖水平靜，湖面巨大，一眼望不到邊。
sentences.pinyin: nán hú dào le hú shuǐ píng jìng hú miàn jù dà yì yǎn wàng bú dào biān
sentences.english: They arrived at the South Lake. The waters of the lake were calm, its surface vast, stretching beyond the horizon.

sentences.simplified: 岸边有个大亭子，这就是南湖亭。
sentences.traditional: 岸邊有個大亭子，這就是南湖亭。
sentences.pinyin: àn biān yǒu ge dà tíng zi zhè jiù shì nán hú tíng
sentences.english: There was a large pavilion by the shore. This was the South Lake Pavilion.

sentences.simplified: 天气好的时候，会有一些书生来这里游玩。
sentences.traditional: 天氣好的時候，會有一些書生來這裡遊玩。
sentences.pinyin: tiān qì hǎo de shí hou huì yǒu yì xiē shū shēng lái zhè lǐ yóu wán
sentences.english: When the weather is nice, some scholars would come here for leisure.

sentences.simplified: 包拯和公孙策在亭子里仔细看了半天，没有发现线索。
sentences.traditional: 包拯和公孫策在亭子裡仔細看了半天，沒有發現線索。
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng hé gōng sūn cè zài tíng zi lǐ zǐ xì kàn le bàn tiān méi yǒu fā xiàn xiàn suǒ
sentences.english: Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce carefully examined the pavilion for a long time but found no clues.

sentence_translations: Chapter 4: Biological Father
Dense dark clouds gathered. On the main road leading to the South Lake Pavilion, two men and two horses were galloping.
They were Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce.
“Without any clues, you actually said you would atone with your life. Do you have a death wish?”
After leaving Kaifeng Mansion, Gongsun Ce kept scolding Bao Zheng all the way.
Gongsun Ce was a private advisor at Kaifeng Mansion, which meant he was Bao Zheng’s assistant.
He was tall and thin, with fair skin, and exuded a scholarly air. Therefore, he looked more like a scholar than a private advisor.
He had been working at Kaifeng Mansion for many years. Besides being a private advisor, he was also Bao Zheng’s best friend.
When he heard about the case of the bloodstained garment from Bao Zheng, he immediately became worried.
This case was different from the usual ones.
This time, the people under investigation were princes and the imperial palace, and maybe even someone more important.
This was too difficult and too dangerous.
“We are currently going to look for clues! Don’t worry, there will definitely be clues at the South Lake Pavilion!”
Bao Zheng’s tone was relaxed, and he was even smiling.
Gongsun Ce became even angrier. He kicked his horse’s belly and rode ahead, ignoring Bao Zheng.
Bao Zheng caught up, suppressed his smile, and said sincerely, ..
.. “I know you are worried about me, but I believe that, like me, you can’t say ‘no’ to a son who cares about his father.
It doesn’t matter whether his son is the emperor or not. I must bring the Eighth Prince back.”
Yes, despite the scolding, Gongsun Ce and Bao Zheng were actually the same kind of person.
They both couldn’t say “no” to the emperor who cared about his father.
Emperor Zhao Zhen was not the son of the late emperor, but the only son of the Eighth Prince.
This was something that everyone in the country knew.
Zhao Zhen grew up in the prince’s mansion. In the year he turned seventeen, the crown prince in the palace fell ill and died.
The emperor had no other sons. The crown prince was the only candidate to be the next emperor.
The death of the crown prince meant that the future emperor was dead, and the country would immediately fall into chaos.
The grieving emperor thought for a long time. He thought of his younger brother’s son.
The emperor’s younger brother was the Eighth Prince, and the Eighth Prince’s son was Zhao Zhen.
The emperor brought seventeen-year-old Zhao Zhen into the palace and made him the new crown prince.
Three years later, the emperor died, and the crown prince Zhao Zhen became the emperor.
Before entering the palace, Zhao Zhen had always lived with the Eighth Prince.
The Eighth Prince also only had one son, Zhao Zhen. The wife of the Eighth Prince passed away not long after Zhao Zhen was born.
After that, the Eighth Prince did not remarry. He gave all his love to his son. Now, who had kidnapped the Eighth Prince?
He was the biological father of the emperor. Who could be so audacious? And what was the purpose of the kidnapping?
These were all the questions that Bao Zheng needed to investigate thoroughly, ..
.. and also the reasons why Gongsun Ce was worried about Bao Zheng.
They arrived at the South Lake. The waters of the lake were calm, its surface vast, stretching beyond the horizon.
There was a large pavilion by the shore. This was the South Lake Pavilion.
When the weather is nice, some scholars would come here for leisure.
Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce carefully examined the pavilion for a long time but found no clues.
